intro: Birb... something is buried beneath this world.
Fragments of what I once was. Scattered. Guarded.
I cannot reach them in this form. Your Parrot can.
Send it through the portal. Bring back what was taken from me.

dialogue: You are not like the others...
Your feathers... they shine with potential.
I am weak... trapped in this form.
And I shall grant you power beyond comprehension.
evoCinematic1: Ahhh... at last. The shell creates cracks.
I can breathe again... after eons of slumber.
You have done well, little one. But this is only the beginning.
Stay by my side, Birb. Together... we shall reshape reality itself.
evoCinematic2: My form shifts... The dungeon can barely contain me.
Do you see, Birb? The universe is vast, and I am hungry.
Let us proceed to the next stage of existence.
evoCinematic3: Excellent... The structure of this world becomes clear.
I can see the codes... the numbers behind the veil.
We are not finished yet, little one.
Just one more step to reach the absolute.
evoCinematic4: The chains are gone. I am no longer bound by this realm.
You have served me well. Now, witness the true nature of the cosmos.

misc.monsterKidnappedNextEvolutionHint: RESCUE THE MONSTER. BREAK THE CYCLE.
misc.nestTreeInteriorDetail: Enter the inside of the Nest Tree.
misc.indexExpeditionChestDesc: Legacy Material Chest. No longer drops, but saved stock can still be opened.
misc.indexArtifactChestDesc: Guaranteed from boss and elite kills. Always drops artifacts by chest rarity.
misc.artifact_desc_uncommon_spirit_trash: A steadier spiritual aura drawn from expedition.
misc.artifact_desc_epic_spirit_trash: Refined spiritual aura compressed from expedition.
misc.artifact_desc_legendary_spirit_trash: An ancient spiritual aura condensed to its limit.
misc.artifact_desc_gold_ore: A dense legendary ore used by the forge.
misc.artifact_desc_strange_key: A legendary key with no known origin. Its teeth fit a lock that does not exist in this world.
misc.artifact_desc_single_boot: On kill: +20% Attack Speed and Move Speed for 3s.
misc.artifact_desc_legendary_book: Each cleared floor: +8% Damage and Max HP.
misc.artifact_desc_money_bag: +5% Spirit Aura chance and +5% Move Speed.
misc.artifact_desc_mythic_book: Other artifacts grant +8% Damage each. 2 copies: +12% each.
misc.artifact_desc_pile_of_points: 10% chance: triple Points (15% with 2 copies). Jackpot: +10% Attack Speed and +5% Range for 3s (doubled for 5s with 2 copies).
misc.artifact_desc_predator_instinct: First hit above 85% HP: +45% Damage. 2 copies: +67.5%. Scales with Infusion.
misc.artifact_desc_echo_shell: Below 60% HP: up to +50% Health Regen at 20% HP. 2 copies: +75%. Scales with Infusion.
misc.artifact_desc_blood_beak: Below 70% HP: up to +24% Damage at 20% HP. 2 copies: +36%. Scales with Infusion.
misc.artifact_desc_relentless_hunter: Same-target hits within 2.5s: +4% Damage/hit (max 7). 2 copies: +6%/hit. Scales with Infusion.
misc.artifact_desc_storm_locket: Every 6th hit: 90% chain damage to 2 enemies. 2 copies: 100% to 3. Scales with Infusion.
misc.artifact_desc_minor_heal_pot: Heals 20% HP. Press G to quick use.
misc.artifact_desc_full_potion: Heals 35% HP. Press G to quick use.
misc.artifact_desc_full_recovery_pot: Heals 50% HP. Press G to quick use.
misc.hatRequirementBridgeSpeed: Cross the bridge in under {seconds} seconds.
misc.hatRequirementShinyBuffs: Have {target} shiny buffs active at the same time.
misc.itemDetailsHint: Hover or click an item to inspect stats and actions.
misc.itemDetailsHoverHint: Hover an item to inspect. Click to equip. Shift+Click sells items for chests.
misc.shiftClickSellForChests: SHIFT+CLICK AN ITEM TO SELL IT
misc.clickEquipShiftSellRightClickLock: Click to equip. SHIFT CLICK TO SELL FOR {reward}. Right-click to lock.
misc.clickEquipRightClickLock: Click to equip. Right-click to lock.
misc.defaultGearHint: Default gear. Upgrade system coming soon.
misc.fishingTipBody1: Your newest rod boosts the fish needed to unlock the next rod. Use it to progress faster.
misc.fishingTipBody2: Right-click fish to lock them from auto-sell.
misc.fishingTipBody3: Click on a fish name after selecting it to view its Fishdex entry.
misc.fishingTipBody4: Shiny fish buffs give 3x power for 24 hours, then continue as normal fish buffs.
misc.confirmResetSkillsForChests: Are you sure you want to reset your skill points for {cost} SP? The cost is deducted from the refunded points.
misc.shiftSellInventoryHint: Click on an item in Inventory or Hotbar while holding SHIFT to sell it for the listed reward!
misc.equipmentUpgradeHint: Use Spirit Aura for equipment upgrades. Sacrifice Room milestones are unlocked with Skill Points.
misc.equipmentMineHintTitle: The forge needs a deeper metal
misc.equipmentMineHintBody: Feather Punch, Feather Armor, and the Parrot Aura have absorbed all the Spirit Aura they can hold. The Crow found signs of a denser metal behind the sealed mine entrance on Expedition Floor 1.
misc.equipmentMineHintObjective: Travel to the Floor 1 Dungeon. Break the mine entrance bars and search the mineral veins for rarer metals.
misc.artifactChestUnlockRequirement: Earn an Artifact Chest in an Expedition to unlock this button.
misc.equipmentUpgradeUnlockHint: Unlock by sacrificing Skill Points in the Sacrifice Room (Milestone I).
misc.auraAutoConvertHint: Optional. Refines complete 50:1 batches whenever Aura is acquired.
misc.auraAutoConvertCommonLocked: Max Spirit Scouting, Spirit Shell, and Spirit Momentum in the Sunflower Field, then finish equipment upgrades that still use Common Aura.
misc.auraAutoConvertLocked: Finish every upgrade that still uses {tier} Aura first.
misc.auraConverterSelectHint: SELECT A SPIRIT AURA TO CONVERT.
misc.seagullGuideBody: Your seagull automatically catches fish for you while you play! It gains XP from each catch.
misc.seagullGuideFeature2: Rebirb at LV 50 (+5 per rebirb) for permanent bonuses
misc.seagullGuideFeature3: You do not lose rebirb progress when you evolve
misc.damageBonusTooltipLine1: Bonus compares final damage to raw base.
misc.damageBonusTooltipLine2: Feather Punch applies a low multiplier (x0.10), so early bonus can show negative.
misc.damageBonusTooltipLine3: This is expected scaling, not a permanent penalty.
misc.buildPointsTooltipLine2: Sacrifice Room uses only Available points.
misc.infusionSelectHint: Select an artifact and press Infuse to power it up.
misc.fusionSelectHint: Add 3 same-rarity artifacts to forge a higher rarity one.
misc.forgeUnlockRequirements: Requires Milestone I and {amount} Common Aura.
misc.forgeWorkbenchHint: Pick an artifact from your bag, then spend Skill Points to amplify its stats.
misc.forgeDropHint: Choose an artifact from the grid →
misc.forgeDetailsHint: Click an artifact to load it into the forge. Infuse / Add to Forge in details works here too.
misc.forgeSelectArtifactHint: Select an artifact in the grid below
misc.sparrowGuideBody: Your sparrow gains XP by collecting popcorn automatically!
misc.resonanceHelpLine1: Sacrificed XP increases this multiplier. More sacrificed XP means more Popcorn and Seed gains.
misc.resonanceHelpLine2: Tip: Sparrow gains more XP at high levels. Drain only part of your XP while it is high level, and avoid draining it all.
misc.mitosisHelpLine1: Fill this bar with total Sparrow XP value. When full, Mitosis resets your level and XP, then doubles your Sparrow count.
misc.mitosisHelpLine2: Tip: Rebirb unlocks only after max sparrows + Nest Tier 1.
misc.parrotExpeditionGuide1: Enter Expeditions from the hub portal and push through floors, bosses and secret rooms.
misc.parrotExpeditionGuide2: Parrot earns Skill Points by killing expedition enemies. Spend them on the SKILLS tab.
misc.parrotExpeditionGuide3: Normal enemies have a 20% base Loot chance for Spirit Aura; Loot Chance bonuses apply. Potions use an independent chance. Elite enemies and bosses drop Equipment Chests.
misc.parrotExpeditionGuide4: You can open Equipment Chests from the EQUIPMENT tab chest slot even during active runs.
misc.parrotExpeditionGuide5: Use EQUIPMENT to equip artifacts and stack bonuses for damage, HP, utility and more.
misc.noArtifactsMatchFilters: No artifacts match the current filters.
misc.noMaterialsMatchFilters: No materials match the current filters.
misc.seagullMilestoneEchoTip: 8% chance to catch the same fish twice! Double the loot!
misc.seagullMilestoneSpecialistTip: Unlock a 3rd seagull that only catches Rare+ fish (slower interval).
misc.seagullMilestoneDailyLegendaryTip: Guaranteed Legendary fish catch every {hours} hours! Daily shiny chance {chance}%.
misc.seagullMilestoneMoonlitTip: Shiny chance scales with time since the last shiny catch.
misc.seagullMilestoneFrenzyTip: Activate Frenzy to catch fish 2x faster for 30 seconds! Costs 10% of your Golden Feathers.
misc.seagullMilestoneFlockTip: Unlock a second seagull that fishes alongside the first one, doubling your catch rate!
misc.seagullMilestoneWisdomTip: Seagull XP also grants {share}% of that XP to your Sparrow! Two birds, one fish.
misc.seagullMilestoneInstinctTip: Seagull Reborn unlocked! Requires Evolution 4. +3% Shiny chance.
misc.enemyMaskedForestSpiritDesc: A balanced forest stalker that pressures the player with steady melee hits.
misc.enemyTwigBlightDesc: Fast close-range attacker found in forest lanes and corridor packs.
misc.enemyGiantFlyDesc: A tougher enemy that can spawn mini flies while fighting.
misc.enemyAnubisDesc: A floor boss that throws cursed ankhs and summons undead reinforcements from coffins.
misc.enemyMummyDesc: A relentless cursed guardian from floor 3 that pressures with steady melee attacks.
misc.enemyAnubisWarriorDesc: An ancient tomb sentinel that swaps between ranged curses and close slashes.
misc.enemyFlowerMonsterDesc: Lurks underground, then erupts from the soil before sprinting into melee range.
misc.enemyMiniFlyDesc: Summoned by Giant Fly. Fast and fragile, gives no XP or Loot.
misc.enemyHarpyDesc: A swift airborne hunter that dives into close-range attacks.
misc.enemyGhoulDesc: An undead skirmisher with cobra-like attack patterns and fast melee pressure.
misc.enemySkeletonWarriorDesc: A relentless bones-and-blade fighter with long combo attacks.
misc.enemyWitchDesc: A floor boss caster that attacks from range and hexes the parrot.
misc.enemyCobraDesc: A venomous striker that inflicts poison after landing attacks.
misc.reachDeeperToDiscoverEnemy: Reach deeper expedition floors to discover this enemy entry.
misc.openChestsToRevealReward: Collect this reward from Expedition Loot at least once to reveal it.
misc.adminGameSpeedHint: DEBUG ONLY · RESETS TO 1x ON RELOAD
misc.adminConfirmResetTwigProgress: Reset Nest tier, current twigs, tree progress, and twig tutorial state? Twig shop upgrades stay untouched.
misc.adminModerationMoved: Leaderboard moderation moved to the standalone admin app.
misc.adminConfirmUnbanAll: Are you sure you want to unban EVERYONE from the leaderboard?
misc.adminConfirmClearAllWarning:
WARNING: This will DELETE ALL leaderboard entries permanently!

Type "DELETE" to confirm.
misc.adminDeleteCancelled: Cancelled. You must type DELETE exactly.
misc.adminConfirmBanEntry: BAN "{name}"? They will be removed and blocked from submitting scores.
misc.adminConfirmResetAllProgress: This will DELETE all progress and restart the game. Are you sure?
misc.wardrobeHint: Mouse wheel zooms the live preview. Changes save instantly.
misc.aquariumDonateAllBody1: This will donate one normal copy from up to {amount} species.
misc.aquariumDonateAllBody2: Locked and reserved copies are kept safe.
misc.aquariumDonateAllBody3: Donated fish live in their biome and cannot be returned to inventory.
misc.aquariumReservedCopiesKept: Copies needed for pending unlocks cannot be donated.
misc.aquariumEmptyBiomeFilterHint: No species match this biome filter.
misc.aquariumNoFishReadyDonate: No normal fish are ready to donate.
misc.aquariumNoAquariumBonuses: Donate fish and complete biome tiers to activate Aquarium bonuses.
misc.aquariumNeedAquariumForShiny: You need to be at the Aquarium to add shiny fish.
misc.aquariumShinyAlreadyStored: This shiny chance bonus is already stored.
misc.aquariumEmptyAllHint: Catch fish to reveal them. Study normal copies or add shiny fish for shiny chance.
misc.aquariumStudyAllBody1: This will use all normal fish that are not locked and can still gain Aquarium mastery.
misc.aquariumStudyAllBody2: It keeps fish needed for rods, hooks, lures, or upgrades.
misc.aquariumStudyAllBody3: Lock any extra fish you want to keep before confirming.
misc.aquariumRewardNormalFishBuffMult: All normal fish buffs increased by {value}
misc.aquariumFishMarketLockedPoints: Reach {points} Resonance Points to unlock the Fish Market.
misc.aquariumHelpStudyDuplicates: Donate one normal copy to house a species in its biome.
misc.aquariumHelpAddShiny: Donate its shiny copy to double that species points and chance bonus.
misc.aquariumHelpPermanentChance: Biome tiers turn collection progress into themed permanent buffs.
misc.aquariumHelpHeavier: Record weight still strengthens the bonus of shiny-upgraded species.
misc.aquariumHelpResonance: Resonance uses collection points, so shiny fish accelerate but never gate progress.
misc.aquariumReasonTravelToAquariumDonate: Travel to the Aquarium to donate fish.
misc.aquariumReasonAlreadyHoused: This species already lives in the Aquarium.
misc.aquariumReasonShinyAlreadyDonated: This species already has its shiny upgrade.
misc.aquariumReasonOnlyShinyCanBeAdded: Only shiny fish can be added.
misc.aquariumReasonTravelToAquariumRelease: Travel to the Aquarium to release fish.
misc.aquariumPassiveNodeDescription: {name} has a {label} active fish buff. Aquarium storage grants shiny chance instead.
misc.aquariumMilestoneExtraCourseDescription: Unlock one more active fish buff slot.
misc.aquariumMilestoneGlassTideDescription: Increase shiny fish buff duration by 12 hours.
misc.aquariumMilestoneDeepResonanceDescriptio: +1% shiny fish chance for every fish in the Aquarium.
misc.aquariumMilestoneAquariumHarmonyDescript: All normal fish buffs are increased by 25%.
misc.aquariumMilestoneMarketRerollsDescriptio: Gain 3 rerolls for the market list.
misc.currencyBadgesHelp: AUTO uses the normal unlock/map rules. OFF hides the badge. ON forces the badge visible.
misc.twigsTooltip: Manual and automated resource for the nest
misc.mineCollapseRoyalCacheEarned: +{amount} Deep Cores for Royal Core Cache
misc.mineCollapseConfirmBody: This uses {amount} Brute Ore earned this run and resets spendable Mine currencies plus temporary Mine upgrades.
misc.mineCollapseConfirmReset: Will reset: Brute Ore, Ore Bars, Ore Value, Ore Respawn, Ore Cap, run-earned progress
misc.desertTutorialUseTopArrow: Use the top arrow to enter the Desert.
misc.evolutionPortalLine1: Finally! I can return to my true form
misc.evolutionPortalLine2: Did you think you would get away this easily?
misc.evolutionPortalLine3: I'll put you in a place no birb can find
misc.mineCollapseSoon: Royal Core Cache is available after Collapse VI.
misc.mineCollapseResetHint: Collapsing resets Brute Ore, Ore Bars, Ore Value, Ore Respawn, Ore Cap, and run-earned progress. Permanent Mine upgrades stay.
misc.crowHelpDesc: Crow gains XP whenever ore nodes break. Higher Crow levels lower the mining interval. After Crow Contract, Crow mines automatically and keeps working while you are away from the mine.
misc.crowDrainHelpDesc: Crow handles the metalwork in the Parrot Forge. Pick a target there, drain Ore Bars into it, then reinforce a full charge with Legendary Spirit Aura. Gold Temper trades Gold Ore for a lower Aura cost.
misc.crowDrainArmorHelpDesc: Unlocked by Anvil Perch. Ore Bars drained here increase Parrot HP.
misc.crowDrainCoreHelpDesc: Unlocked by Core-Set Armor. Ore Bars drained here increase Parrot Damage and mine ore damage.
misc.crowDrainRivetsHelpDesc: Unlocked by Load-Bearing Rivets. Ore Bars drained here increase Parrot Regen and combat regen relief.
misc.crowForgeMetalworkSubtitle: Ore Bars flow into the selected equipment. Reinforce normally or use Gold Temper to lower the Legendary Spirit Aura cost.
misc.crowForgeFullChargeTooltip: Fill the charge before choosing a reinforcement.
misc.crowForgeGoldTemperTitle: Gold Temper: {aura} Legendary Spirit Aura + {gold} Gold Ore. Saves {saved} Aura.
misc.crowPlatingLocked: Unlock {upgrade} to use Metal Drain and Blackfeather Plating.
misc.crowPlatingHelpDesc: Levels come from Metal Drain and Royal Core Cache. Plating adds Parrot HP; Core-Set Armor adds mine damage every 10 levels; Load-Bearing Rivets adds combat regen relief.
misc.crowContractLocked: Buy Crow Contract in the Treasure Room.
misc.crowRebirbHelpDesc: Unlocked by Anvil Perch. Rebirb resets Crow level and XP for permanent mine bonuses: higher ore value and XP, faster mining, a lower interval floor, and extra gold ore chance. Crow drain tracks stay.
misc.crowRebirbBonusLine: Ore x{mult} | Speed x{speed} | XP x{xp} | Min {floor}s | Gold +{gold}%
misc.crowRebirbConfirmLine1: Crow returns to LV 1 from LV {level}.
misc.crowRebirbConfirmLine2: Permanent mine bonuses increase and Crow drain tracks stay.
misc.twigWoodChainChopDescription: Chance to also hit the closest tree
misc.parrotRebirbResetParrot: Parrot level, XP, skill points, and skills
misc.parrotRebirbResetArtifacts: All Parrot artifacts and spirit auras, except the Strange Key
misc.parrotRebirbResetEquipment: Parrot equipment items and current equipped gear
misc.parrotRebirbResetEquipmentUpgrade: Equipment upgrade rarity and levels reset to COMMON I
misc.parrotRebirbKeepProgression: Other expedition progression outside common sacrifice
misc.shinyFishBuffValueLine: {name} is a shiny fish with 3x its normal buff value.
misc.shinyFishBuffExpiresLine: The shiny buff expires in {duration}, turning into a normal fish buff.
misc.parrotRebirbRewardEnemyRespawnHalf: -50% Enemy respawn time, including elites and bosses
misc.biomeGardenOfLilithDesc: A dark, humid wetland filled with mossy waters and hidden dangers.
misc.biomeNightGardenDesc: A wild overgrown floor where tiles and enemies stand out from dense greenery.
misc.biomeGardenOfEdenDesc: A beautiful garden filled with life and danger.
misc.enemyIceHarpyDesc: A frozen floor 6 harpy with the same swooping ranged pressure as the original.
misc.enemyFishfolkArchpriestDesc: A support caster that heals nearby allies and pressures from range.
misc.enemyFishfolkWhipeDesc: A fast melee striker that chains quick close-range attacks.
misc.enemyFishfolkInkbenderDesc: A melee ink fighter with extended combos and sustained pressure.
misc.enemyFishfolkBruteDesc: Floor 4 boss with heavy melee blows and high durability.
misc.enemyFishfolkPugilistDesc: A relentless brawler that builds pressure with chaining punches.
misc.enemySeaHorrorDesc: A deep-sea mauler that rushes into close-range pressure.
misc.enemySeaGramlinDesc: A slippery attacker with quick melee bursts.
misc.enemyElementalDesc: An unstable elemental that mixes direct strikes with a special orbit attack.
misc.enemyFishfolkHorrorDesc: Floor 5 boss with brutal pressure and heavy close-range hits.
misc.enemyFrostWispDesc: A fast floor 6 spirit that lunges in close and reforms after respawning.
misc.enemyArcticWhisperDesc: A floor 6 ice spirit that advances calmly and bursts in a close AoE attack.
misc.enemyFrozyCubeDesc: A compact floor 6 ice construct that slides in and hits with a sharp melee burst.
misc.enemyFrostySlimeDesc: Floor 6 boss that leaps forward and slams the ground with a wide icy splash.
misc.enemyIceFireGuardianDesc: A stronger floor 6 guardian that only starts appearing deeper in the frozen run.
misc.enemyFrogfolkWizardDesc: A floor 7 swamp caster that fights with quick magic strikes.
misc.enemyFrogfolkBruteDesc: A heavy floor 7 swamp fighter with a long tongue strike.
misc.enemyFrogfolkChieftainDesc: The floor 7 swamp boss who commands the frogfolk from the deepest mire.
misc.enemyGhostDesc: A floor 8 specter that fades out, reforms, and rushes in with chilling melee pressure.
misc.enemyDoppelgangerDesc: A floor 8 mimic that hides its real shape before transforming into a close-range threat.
misc.enemyBlackPuddingDesc: A floor 8 ooze that slides low across the ground and lashes out with heavy close-range attacks.
misc.enemyGiantBlackPuddingDesc: The floor 8 boss, a towering ooze that emerges from below and crushes the arena with sweeping attacks.
misc.enemyHellCritterDesc: A restless creature reconstructed from scraps of older worlds. It rushes prey with quick close-range attacks.
misc.enemyImpDesc: A ranged sentry following routes copied from a world that no longer exists. It keeps its distance and fires straight-line firebolts.
misc.enemyCacodaemonDesc: A predator branded with numbers visible only beneath the Veil. It locks onto its target and attacks with a straight charge.
misc.enemyCultistDesc: A devoted attendant that chants the dates of forgotten cycles and sacrifices itself to awaken the Archivist's true form.
misc.enemyCultistBruteDesc: A heavy cultist armored with fragments of earlier floors. It hunts intruders with forceful melee attacks.
misc.enemyTheArchivistDesc: The keeper of every failed cycle. It does not create monsters; it restores them from records, using five willing sacrifices to assume its true form.
misc.aquariumTutorialWelcomeBody: Donate one fish per species to house it in a themed biome. Every resident grants points and a permanent shiny chance bonus.
misc.aquariumTutorialStudyBody: I added 1 Swarm Krill as an example. Open Creatures, select it, and press Donate to give it a home.
misc.aquariumTutorialDonateBody: I added 1 Swarm Krill as an example. Open Creatures, select it, and press Donate to give it a home.
misc.aquariumTutorialShinyBody: I added 1 shiny Swarm Krill. Donate Shiny to give the resident its random shiny color and double its species points and chance bonus.
misc.aquariumTutorialResonanceBody: The Resonance tab turns resident rarity into points. Every milestone is reachable with normal fish; shiny upgrades simply get you there faster.
misc.aquariumTutorialMasteryBody: Each biome grants stronger themed buffs at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% completion. Upgrade every resident to shiny for a prestige tier.
misc.aquariumTutorialBiomesBody: Each biome grants stronger themed buffs at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% completion. Upgrade every resident to shiny for a prestige tier.
misc.nestTierCozyDesc: Lined with soft feathers. Unlocks 3 new automation upgrades.
misc.aurelianResonancePerLevel: +100 to Golden Twig Multiplier per level
misc.parrotRebirbMilestoneUnlocksII: +1 artifact slot, 4x Parrot points, +0.1% points/level, -50% respawn time
misc.bonusOverviewHint: Active multipliers by effect type. Click a row to see each source.

tutorial.welcomeDesc: You are a pigeon. Use WASD to move.
tutorial.mobileWelcomeDesc: You are a pigeon. TOUCH AND DRAG across the field to move.
tutorial.mobileControlsDesc: The movement pad appears wherever you touch and disappears when you release.
tutorial.travelDesc: Use arrows to find new lands.
tutorial.expeditionParrotDesc: Your Parrot fights automatically. Stay close and keep it alive.
tutorial.expeditionAutoDesc: Rapid-click the same enemy to restart attacks and strike faster, or turn AUTO on to choose targets for you. Try either, then press Next.
tutorial.expeditionSelectParrotDesc: Choose PARROT to manage its upgrades and equipment.
tutorial.expeditionSkillsDesc: Enemies grant Skill Points. Open COMPANIONS [TAB] and choose a skill.
tutorial.expeditionBuildDesc: Damage clears faster. Vitality and Recovery keep the Parrot alive. These upgrades remain between runs.
tutorial.expeditionGearDesc: Elite enemies and bosses can drop Artifact Chests. Open EQUIPMENT to claim one now.
tutorial.artifactChestOpenDesc: Select the highlighted chest button. It remains locked until you own at least one Artifact Chest.
tutorial.artifactChestClaimDesc: Open one chest to reveal its artifact. Each chest consumes only when its reward is successfully added.
tutorial.artifactChestRewardDesc: The new artifact is now in the Equipment inventory, ready to equip or use in the Forge.
tutorial.expeditionGearAndChestsDesc: Artifacts shape your build. Beak, Armor, and Aura improve base stats. Open collected chests from this screen.
tutorial.expeditionReadyDesc: Close the Parrot menu when ready. The Expedition resumes immediately.
tutorial.parrotForgeWelcomeDesc: The Forge has four work areas. Use the highlighted tabs to move between EQUIPMENT, INFUSION, FUSION, and AUTO REFINE.
tutorial.parrotForgeEquipmentDesc: Open EQUIPMENT. This tab improves Parrot gear and processes Aura materials.
tutorial.parrotForgeWorkbenchDesc: Upgrade Beak, Armor, and Aura here. The material inventory below also lets you convert Aura upward or dismantle it into a lower tier.
tutorial.parrotForgeFirstUpgradeDesc: Spend 10 COMMON AURA on Beak, Armor, or Aura. The Forge unlocks only after Milestone I is complete and this first upgrade is affordable.
tutorial.parrotForgeInfusionOpenDesc: Select INFUSION to strengthen one artifact without changing its identity.
tutorial.parrotForgeInfusionWorkbenchDesc: Choose an artifact from the bag. Infusion spends that artifact's Skill Points and previews the next power multiplier before you confirm.
tutorial.parrotForgeFusionOpenDesc: Select FUSION to combine artifacts into a higher rarity.
tutorial.parrotForgeFusionWorkbenchDesc: Choose three unequipped artifacts of the same rarity from the bag. Fusion consumes them plus the shown Aura and creates one artifact of the next rarity.
tutorial.parrotForgeLockedDesc: Infusion, Fusion, and Auto Refine unlock after the first Spirit Aura sacrifice milestone. Their tabs show the exact missing progress.
tutorial.parrotForgeInventoryDesc: Filters help find a type, rarity, or equipment status. Clicking an item assigns it to the active recipe; no action is final until you press its confirmation button.
tutorial.crowMetalworkTargetDesc: Click an unlocked equipment card to choose which permanent track receives Ore Bars: Armor improves HP, Beak improves mine damage, and Aura improves combat regeneration.
tutorial.crowMetalworkRequirementsDesc: Metalwork targets need their matching Mine upgrade and Legendary +5 equipment. Locked cards show what is still missing.
tutorial.crowMetalworkOpenDesc: Expand the highlighted panel to control the selected equipment track.
tutorial.crowMetalworkRateDesc: Choose how much Ore Bar income flows into this track. OFF preserves all bars; 25%, 50%, and 100% trade current income for permanent charge.
tutorial.crowMetalworkProgressDesc: The bar shows stored Ore Bars and the amount needed for the next permanent level. Changing targets never erases progress already stored in another track.
tutorial.crowMetalworkFinishDesc: At full charge, choose Normal Reinforcement or Gold Temper. Gold Temper spends Gold Ore to reduce the Legendary Spirit Aura cost; nothing is spent before you confirm.
tutorial.sparrowUnlockedDesc: A sparrow now helps in the Meadow. It collects popcorn automatically and gains XP while it works.
tutorial.sparrowOpenMenuDesc: Select SPARROW to open its companion panel.
tutorial.sparrowProgressDesc: It gains XP while collecting. Each level increases its speed.
tutorial.sparrowGrowthDesc: Spend Seeds here to gain extra XP.
tutorial.seagullOpenCompanionsDesc: Open COMPANIONS [TAB] to meet your fishing companion.
tutorial.seagullOpenMenuDesc: Select SEAGULL to open its companion panel.
tutorial.seagullProgressDesc: Every catch gives Seagull XP. Level up for faster catches, then Rebirb for permanent fleet bonuses.
tutorial.seagullDoctrineDesc: Balanced is neutral, Hunter favors rarer catches, and Training favors XP. Choose one for Seagull 1.
tutorial.seagullBaitDesc: Open this slot. Each Seagull equips and consumes its own bait, affecting only its catches.
tutorial.seagullRouteDesc: The line under its name shows the assigned route and current forecast. More routes unlock later.
tutorial.seagullReadyDesc: Each Seagull fishes automatically. The green timer shows when its next catch will arrive.
tutorial.seedFeederUnlockedDesc: Open COMPANIONS [TAB] to set it up.
tutorial.seedFeederRateDesc: Move the slider to choose how much of your Seed income becomes Sparrow XP.
tutorial.seedFeederStartDesc: Press FEED to start converting Seed income into Sparrow XP.
tutorial.seedFeederReadyDesc: The red rate is Seeds spent per second. The green rate is Sparrow XP gained per second.
tutorial.sparrowMilestonesUnlockedDesc: Evolve 2 unlocked permanent Sparrow milestones. Open COMPANIONS [TAB].
tutorial.sparrowMilestonesDesc: Open the highlighted Milestones bar to see its progression goals.
tutorial.sparrowMilestonesReadyDesc: Complete each goal once to keep its bonus through Mitosis and Evolve resets.
tutorial.sparrowResonanceDesc: Resonance converts Sparrow XP into a multiplier for Popcorn and Seeds.
tutorial.sparrowResonanceDrainDesc: Use this button to start or stop converting current Sparrow XP into Resonance power.
tutorial.sparrowHowDesc: The sparrow gets stronger by collecting popcorn. Open its menu to check level, XP, and current bonuses.
tutorial.fishingDesc: Press SPACE on the bridge to cast. Wait for the bite, then catch the fish.
tutorial.fishingBuffDesc: Caught fish go to your Fish Inventory.
tutorial.fishingAutoDesc: Eat fish from the inventory to activate buffs like Popcorn, Seeds, Reel Speed, Radius, and Fishing XP.
tutorial.fishingBridgeBuffDesc: Caught fish go to your Fish Inventory. Eat fish to activate buffs like Popcorn, Seeds, Reel Speed, Radius, and Fishing XP.
tutorial.fishingBridgeHowDesc: Press SPACE or click the button in the bottom-right corner to cast. Wait for the bite, then catch the fish.
tutorial.fishingBridgeShinyDesc: Shiny fish buffs are much stronger for 24 hours, then continue as normal fish buffs. Right-click fish to lock them before selling.
tutorial.fishingBridgeMonetaDesc: Sell fish to earn Monetaria Moneta. Moneta buys fishing upgrades and can boost fish value later.
tutorial.fishingBridgeRodsDesc: Catch more fish to unlock better rods. Equip bait, hooks, and lures in the Fish Inventory to improve your catches.
tutorial.fishingBridgeEatDesc: Select the fish and click FEED.
tutorial.fishingBridgeActiveBuffDesc: Open BUFFS to see the active bonus.
tutorial.fishingBridgeTreasureDesc: A catch can also reveal a treasure. You keep the fish, and the treasure becomes Moneta instantly. Better rods and upgrades raise the chance.
tutorial.fishingBridgeCoastalBaitDesc: Select Coastal Chum. It catches only COASTAL fish.
tutorial.fishingBridgeBuyBaitDesc: Buy one Coastal Chum with Moneta.
tutorial.fishingBridgeBaitCatchDesc: Cast and catch a COASTAL fish.
tutorial.fishingBridgeFishdexChanceDesc: Highest chances appear first. Bait removes other types; without bait, every available type returns to the pool.
tutorial.fishingBridgeAutoDesc: Make 10 manual catches to unlock AUTO.
tutorial.aquariumUnlockedDesc: You reached Fishing Level 10. Click the highlighted arrow below to visit the Aquarium.
tutorial.currentEndDesc:
You are reaching the current end of content. The game keeps updating constantly, with at least 3 updates per week, and the next BIG update comes soon.

You can keep grinding resources, pushing Expedition floors, and completing your Fishdex and fish masteries if you have not finished them yet, but things start to slow down from here.

If you are enjoying the game, please leave a star review with what you think. It helps a lot.

mapEditor.lightGameplayHint: Lights are rendered with pixelated falloff in gameplay.
mapEditor.manualPortalHint: Use with manual portal sprite placement.

mapEditor.loadedBitmaskFromSelection: Loaded {count}/{total} bitmask entities from selected tile.

mapEditor.deleteToolSupports: Supports deletion of tiles, enemies, and collision boxes.

currencySources.bruteOre: Mine ore veins in the Mine
currencySources.oreBars: Refine Brute Ore at the Refinery
